+def _is_section_title_first_line(content: StringList, index: int) -> bool:
+    """Return True if the line at *index* is the text line of a section
+    title (i.e. it is immediately followed by an "underline" made of a
+    single repeated punctuation character).
+
+    This is used to avoid mistaking the first line of a section title
+    that begins with an interpreted text role (such as ``:mod:`foo```)
+    for a docinfo field, which uses the same ``:name:`` syntax.
+    """
+    try:
+        next_line = content[index + 1]
+    except IndexError:
+        return False
+
+    stripped = next_line.rstrip()
+    if len(stripped) < 4:
+        # docutils ignores very short adornment lines
+        return False
+
+    first_char = stripped[0]
+    if first_char.isalnum() or first_char.isspace():
+        return False
+
+    return all(char == first_char for char in stripped)
+
